title: Bratwurst Braised in Red-Wine With Apple-Celery Root Puree
description: For this cold-weather dinner, 2013 F&W Best New Chef Chris Shepherd browns bratwurst, king oyster mushrooms, and cipollini onions in the same skillet. A buttery celery root and Granny Smith apple puree supplies an earthy, slightly tart base for the meat, vegetables, and red wine sauce.
ingredients: 1 small Granny Smith apple, peeled, cored, and chopped (about 1 cup)
10 ounces king oyster mushrooms, cut lengthwise into 1/2-inch-thick planks
6 ounces cipollini onions (6 to 8 onions), peeled and halved
directions: Make the puree: Place 4 cups water, celery root, and apple in a medium saucepan; bring to a boil over high. Reduce heat to medium, and cook until tender, 8 to 10 minutes; reserve 1/4 cup cooking liquid. Drain celery root mixture through a fine wire-mesh strainer.

Transfer celery root and apple to a blender. Add butter, salt, and pepper; process until smooth, about 2 minutes, adding reserved cooking liquid, 1 tablespoon at a time, as needed for mixture to become silky and smooth. Return puree to saucepan; cover and keep warm.
Make the bratwurst: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium. Add bratwurst; cook, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides, 6 to 8 minutes. Transfer bratwurst to a plate.

Add mushrooms to skillet; cook, turning occasionally, until golden, 3 to 4 minutes. Transfer mushrooms to plate. Add onions to skillet; cook, turning occasionally, until lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer onions to plate with mushrooms.

Add wine and stock to skillet; bring to a boil over high, scraping up browned bits from bottom of skillet. Return bratwurst to skillet. Reduce heat to medium-low; cover and simmer until heated through, about 10 minutes. Transfer bratwurst to a plate; let rest for 5 minutes. Increase heat to medium-high; cook wine mixture until liquid is reduced to about 1 cup, 4 to 5 minutes.

Return mushrooms and onions to skillet. Reduce heat to medium-low; stir in butter, and cook, stirring constantly, until butter is emulsified, about 1 minute. Stir in scallions, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Divide puree evenly among 4 plates; top each with 1 bratwurst. Evenly spoon mushrooms, onions, and sauce over and around puree; garnish with dill fronds, and serve.
